visual.alt: Side view of a player executing a front-contact volley with a stable head.
visual.prompt: A clean, instructional tennis coaching illustration showing an intermediate baseliner performing a volley. Side view, full body. The player stands in a balanced athletic stance with knees bent, weight forward, and feet shoulder-width apart. The racket is held in front of the body with a stable, square racket face; contact point is just in front of the body at chest height. The motion is compact with a short backswing and forward transfer of weight through contact. The head remains steady with eyes on the ball. The non-dominant arm is used for balance. The background is a simple tennis court with a faint net line, kept secondary so the focus is on technique. The illustration uses clean lines and soft colors to emphasize body alignment and movement, not photorealism.
